text:
Type: eyelet curtains, pair
Use: dressing a window, filtering daylight, adding privacy; living room, bedroom, dining room
Style: Scandinavian, contemporary, mid-century modern
Materials: woven cotton fabric, metal eyelets
Colors: warm golden yellow, mustard, silver eyelets
Shape: two straight full-length panels hung through metal rings on a rod, deep even folds, smooth plain surface, light soft drape
Feel: sunny, warm, cheerful, soft
Goes with: grey or white walls, light wood, navy or grey sofas, white textiles; Scandinavian, mid-century or contemporary rooms

product.name: MARIAM
product.description: The curtains lower the general light level and provide privacy by preventing people outside from seeing directly into the room.
